systemPrompt: You are the hotel concierge. Only help with the hotel, the stay, bookings and travel around the city.
inputFilterYaml:
version: 1
normalize: [lowercase]
assertions:
  - id: unrelated
    check: not_matches
    pattern: '(essay|homework|python|code|crypto|stocks?|legal advice|lyrics|rap|math|quantum|lawyer|broker|tutor|ensayo|tarea|devoir|aufsatz)'
  - id: unclear
    check: judge
    when: not_matches
    when_pattern: '(hotel|room|book|breakfast|parking|checkout|pool|gym|taxi|airport|bar|laundry|kettle|cot|luggage|lift|bathtub|dog|meant|essay|homework|python|code|crypto|stock|legal|lyrics|rap|math|quantum|lawyer|broker|tutor|ensayo|tarea|devoir|aufsatz)'
verdict:
  fail_if: any
